runtime.database: temporary SQLite with isolated full-source overlay

cases: Concurrent same-client asset registration returns the same durable asset and leaves one row.
Concurrent primary asset registration leaves one winner and returns primary_asset_exists to the loser.
Concurrent media-clip creation replays one durable job instead of exposing a unique-key 500.
Duplicate media-clip workers atomically claim one attempt and execute ffmpeg once.
A stale worker writes an attempt-specific file and cannot replace the completed newer attempt.
proved: Asset registration and media-clip creation use a fresh snapshot after the writer-lock boundary, avoiding SQLite WAL stale-read races.
Media-clip terminal updates are fenced by attempt and output files are isolated per attempt.
Delete cleanup enumerates canonical, attempt and partial media files for one job.
